---
name: Bug report
about: Report reproducible behavior that violates a Cinis specification
title: '[Bug]: '
---

## Revision and environment

Commit, OS, Rust/Python/PowerShell versions, and relevant configuration without secrets.

## Reproduction

Exact command or smallest fixture, initial state, and deterministic seed if relevant.

## Expected versus observed

Link the requirement/rule/invariant. Distinguish current implementation from planned functionality.

## Evidence

Run ID, exit code, redacted stdout/stderr excerpt, and hosted workflow URL if CI failed. Never paste credentials or environment dumps.

## Impact and workaround

Describe correctness/data effects and any temporary workaround.
